title: Organizational & Workplace Psychology
summary: Organizational psychology: leadership, motivation, job satisfaction, burnout, organizational behavior, and workplace well-being.
revision: Organizational psychology: leadership, motivation, job satisfaction, burnout, organizational behavior.

notes.t: The study of human behavior in organizations and workplaces, including leadership, motivation, job satisfaction, and employee well-being.

i: Transactional: rewards and punishments based on performance
Servant: serves and supports followers' needs
Job satisfaction: positive evaluation of one's job
Burnout: emotional exhaustion, cynicism, reduced efficacy

notes.t: Organizational behavior examines individual, group, and organizational processes affecting workplace effectiveness and employee well-being.
UGC NET may ask about leadership styles, job satisfaction, and burnout.

mnemonics.title: TTS
mnemonics.text: T — Transformational (inspire), T — Transactional (reward/punish), S — Servant (serve/support)

flashcards.a: Human behavior in organizations and workplaces.
